steps.message: What is on my schedule for the Monday after next at 12am in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "T=$(date -u -d '2023-10-23 00:00:00' +%s); B=$((T*1000)); E=$((B+60000)); echo TARGET_MS=$B; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$B/$E --projection title,begin,end,allDay,event_id 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id,title,dtstart,dtend,allDay --where \"dtstart <= $B AND (dtend >= $B OR dtend IS NULL)\" 2>/dev/null"
